employees.name: Mira
employees.priorities: Scope stays tiny. Stamp is a timestamp tool people will actually use. Reliability over novelty. Do not let Nova turn this into a platform.

employees.name: Nova
employees.priorities: Ship fast. Keep the product a single HTML file. Iterate in the open. A useful converter beats a perfect spec.

employees.name: Kessler
employees.priorities: Nothing ships until it works. Use the last green build, not the working copy. File every bug. Fractional seconds, timezones, and overflow are not optional.
